SOLAR_PRE[_k] = SOLAR_PRE[_k - 1] + SOLAR_SIN[_k]\n\nSLIP_MID = {k: 0.5 * (v[0] + v[1]) for k, v in PHYSICS[\"slip_base_ranges\"].items()}\n\n\nclass NavGraph:\n    def __init__(self, surf: Surface, margin: float = 0.03):\n        self.surf = surf\n        self.nx = surf.nx\n        self.ny = surf.ny\n        self.cell = surf.cell\n        self.max_tilt = PHYSICS[\"max_tilt\"] - margin\n\n        self.safe_pt = [[False] * self.nx for _ in range(self.ny)]\n        for j in range(self.ny):\n            y0 = j * self.cell\n            for i in range(self.nx):\n                _, gx, gy, _ = surf.sample(i * self.cell, y0)\n                self.safe_pt[j][i] = (math.hypot(gx, gy) <= self.max_tilt)\n\n        dirs = [(dx, dy) for dx in range(-2, 3) for dy in range(-2, 3)\n                if (dx != 0 or dy != 0) and math.gcd(abs(dx), abs(dy)) == 1]\n\n        self.adj: List[List[List[Tuple[int, int, float, float]]]] = [\n            [[] for _ in range(self.nx)] for _ in range(self.ny)\n        ]\n        for j in range(self.ny):\n            y0 = j * self.cell\n            for i in range(self.nx):\n                if not self.safe_pt[j][i]:\n                    continue\n                x0 = i * self.cell\n                h0 = surf.h[j][i]\n                for dx, dy in dirs:\n                    ni, nj = i + dx, j + dy\n                    if not (0 <= ni < self.nx and 0 <= nj < self.ny) or not self.safe_pt[nj][ni]:\n                        continue\n                    x1, y1 = ni * self.cell, nj * self.cell\n                    L = math.hypot(x1 - x0, y1 - y0)\n                    steps = int(math.ceil(L / 1.0))\n                    ok = True\n                    max_s = 0.0\n                    for s in range(1, steps):\n                        t = s / steps\n                        _, gx, gy, _ = surf.sample(x0 + (x1 - x0) * t, y0 + (y1 - y0) * t)\n                        slp = math.hypot(gx, gy)\n                        if slp > self.max_tilt:\n                            ok = False\n                            break\n                        if slp > max_s:\n                            max_s = slp\n                    if not ok:\n                        continue\n                    ux, uy = (x1 - x0) / L, (y1 - y0) / L\n                    dt_sum = 0.0\n                    e_sum = 0.0\n                    n_sub = 2 if L <= 7.5 else 3\n                    ds = L / n_sub\n                    prev_h = h0\n                    for s in range(n_sub):\n                        xm = x0 + (x1 - x0) * ((s + 0.5) / n_sub)\n                        ym = y0 + (y1 - y0) * ((s + 0.5) / n_sub)\n                        _, gx, gy, code = surf.sample(xm, ym)\n                        name = TERRAIN_CODES[code]\n                        grade = gx * ux + gy * uy\n                        slip = min(0.95, max(0.0, SLIP_MID[name] + PHYSICS[\"slip_grade_gain\"][name] * max(0.0, grade)))\n                        wheel_ds = ds / (1.0 - slip)\n                        dt_sum += wheel_ds / 5.0\n                        he = surf.elevation(x0 + (x1 - x0) * ((s + 1) / n_sub), y0 + (y1 - y0) * ((s + 1) / n_sub))\n                        e_sum += wheel_ds * PHYSICS[\"drive_cost_per_wheel_m\"][name] + PHYSICS[\"climb_cost_per_m\"] * max(0.0, he - prev_h)\n                        prev_h = he\n                    # Small penalty near high slopes to keep safer buffer\n                    if max_s > 0.28:\n                        dt_sum += (max_s - 0.28) * 3.0\n                    self.adj[j][i].append((ni, nj, dt_sum, e_sum))\n\n    def nearest_safe_vertices(self, x: float, y: float) -> List[Tuple[int, int, float, float]]:\n        fx, fy = x / self.cell, y / self.cell\n        i0 = min(self.nx - 2, max(0, int(fx)))\n        j0 = min(self.ny - 2, max(0, int(fy)))\n        cands = []\n        for di in (0, 1):\n            for dj in (0, 1):\n                ni, nj = i0 + di, j0 + dj\n                if self.safe_pt[nj][ni]:\n                    vx, vy = ni * self.cell, nj * self.cell\n                    L = math.hypot(vx - x, vy - y)\n                    dt, de = self.segment_cost(x, y, vx, vy)\n                    if dt < 1e8:\n                        cands.append((ni, nj, dt, de))\n        if not cands:\n            best = []\n            for r in range(1, 5):\n                for di in range(-r, r + 1):\n                    for dj in range(-r, r + 1):\n                        ni, nj = i0 + di, j0 + dj\n                        if 0 <= ni < self.nx and 0 <= nj < self.ny and self.safe_pt[nj][ni]:\n                            vx, vy = ni * self.cell, nj * self.cell\n                            L = math.hypot(vx - x, vy - y)\n                            best.append((L, ni, nj))\n                if best:\n                    best.sort()\n                    _, ni, nj = best[0]\n                    vx, vy = ni * self.cell, nj * self.cell\n                    cands.append((ni, nj, math.hypot(vx - x, vy - y) / 4.2, math.hypot(vx - x, vy - y) * 0.5))\n                    break\n        return cands\n\n    def segment_cost(self, x0: float, y0: float, x1: float, y1: float) -> Tuple[float, float]:\n        L = math.hypot(x1 - x0, y1 - y0)\n        if L < 1e-6:\n            return 0.0, 0.0\n        steps = max(2, int(math.ceil(L / 1.0)))\n        ux, uy = (x1 - x0) / L, (y1 - y0) / L\n        dt_sum = 0.0\n        e_sum = 0.0\n        ds = L / steps\n        prev_h = self.surf.elevation(x0, y0)\n        for s in range(steps):\n            xm = x0 + (x1 - x0) * ((s + 0.5) / steps)\n            ym = y0 + (y1 - y0) * ((s + 0.5) / steps)\n            if not self.surf.inside(xm, ym):\n                return 1e9, 1e9\n            _, gx, gy, code = self.surf.sample(xm, ym)\n            if math.hypot(gx, gy) > self.max_tilt:\n                return 1e9, 1e9\n            name = TERRAIN_CODES[code]\n            grade = gx * ux + gy * uy\n            slip = min(0.95, max(0.0, SLIP_MID[name] + PHYSICS[\"slip_grade_gain\"][name] * max(0.0, grade)))\n            wheel_ds = ds / (1.0 - slip)\n            dt_sum += wheel_ds / 5.0\n            he = self.surf.elevation(x0 + (x1 - x0) * ((s + 1) / steps), y0 + (y1 - y0) * ((s + 1) / steps))\n            e_sum += wheel_ds * PHYSICS[\"drive_cost_per_wheel_m\"][name] + PHYSICS[\"climb_cost_per_m\"] * max(0.0, he - prev_h)\n            prev_h = he\n        return dt_sum, e_sum\n\n    def dijkstra_from_point(self, x: float, y: float, alpha: float):\n        nx, ny = self.nx, self.ny\n        cost = [[1e9] * nx for _ in range(ny)]\n        d = [[1e9] * nx for _ in range(ny)]\n        e = [[1e9] * nx for _ in range(ny)]\n        pq = []\n        for ni, nj, dt, de in self.nearest_safe_vertices(x, y):\n            c = dt + alpha * de\n            if c < cost[nj][ni]:\n                cost[nj][ni] = c\n                d[nj][ni] = dt\n                e[nj][ni] = de\n                heapq.heappush(pq, (c, ni, nj))\n        adj = self.adj\n        while pq:\n            cc, i, j = heapq.heappop(pq)\n            if cc > cost[j][i] + 1e-9:\n                continue\n            cd, ce = d[j][i], e[j][i]\n            for ni, nj, dt, de in adj[j][i]:\n                nc = cc + dt + alpha * de\n                if nc < cost[nj][ni]:\n                    cost[nj][ni] = nc\n                    d[nj][ni] = cd + dt\n                    e[nj][ni] = ce + de\n                    heapq.heappush(pq, (nc, ni, nj))\n        return d, e\n\n    def find_path(self, x0: float, y0: float, x1: float, y1: float, alpha: float) -> Tuple[List[Tuple[float, float]], float, float]:\n        if math.hypot(x1 - x0, y1 - y0) <= 12.0:\n            dt, de = self.segment_cost(x0, y0, x1, y1)\n            if dt < 1e8:\n                return [(x1, y1)], dt, de\n\n        nx, ny = self.nx, self.ny\n        cell = self.cell\n        cost = [[1e9] * nx for _ in range(ny)]\n        d = [[1e9] * nx for _ in range(ny)]\n        e = [[1e9] * nx for _ in range(ny)]\n        parent: Dict[Tuple[int, int], Optional[Tuple[int, int]]] = {}\n        pq = []\n        for ni, nj, dt, de in self.nearest_safe_vertices(x0, y0):\n            c = dt + alpha * de\n            if c < cost[nj][ni]:\n                cost[nj][ni] = c\n                d[nj][ni] = dt\n                e[nj][ni] = de\n                parent[(ni, nj)] = None\n                h = math.hypot(x1 - ni * cell, y1 - nj * cell) / 4.8\n                heapq.heappush(pq, (c + h, c, ni, nj))\n\n        goal_cands = {\n            (ni, nj): (dt, de) for ni, nj, dt, de in self.nearest_safe_vertices(x1, y1)\n        }\n        best_goal = None\n        best_total_c = 1e9\n        best_dt, best_de = 1e9, 1e9\n        adj = self.adj\n\n        while pq:\n            _, cc, i, j = heapq.heappop(pq)\n            if cc > cost[j][i] + 1e-9:\n                continue\n            if cc >= best_total_c:\n                break\n            if (i, j) in goal_cands:\n                gdt, gde = goal_cands[(i, j)]\n                tc = cc + gdt + alpha * gde\n                if tc < best_total_c:\n                    best_total_c = tc\n                    best_goal = (i, j)\n                    best_dt = d[j][i] + gdt\n                    best_de = e[j][i] + gde\n            cd, ce = d[j][i], e[j][i]\n            for ni, nj, dt, de in adj[j][i]:\n                nc = cc + dt + alpha * de\n                if nc < cost[nj][ni]:\n                    cost[nj][ni] = nc\n                    d[nj][ni] = cd + dt\n                    e[nj][ni] = ce + de\n                    parent[(ni, nj)] = (i, j)\n                    h = math.hypot(x1 - ni * cell, y1 - nj * cell) / 4.8\n                    heapq.heappush(pq, (nc + h, nc, ni, nj))\n\n        if best_goal is None:\n            return [(x1, y1)], 1e9, 1e9\n\n        pts = []\n        cur: Optional[Tuple[int, int]] = best_goal\n        while cur is not None:\n            pts.append((cur[0] * cell, cur[1] * cell))\n            cur = parent[cur]\n        pts.reverse()\n        if math.hypot(pts[-1][0] - x1, pts[-1][1] - y1) > 0.2:\n            pts.append((x1, y1))\n        return pts, best_dt, best_de\n\n\nclass StateEstimator:\n    def __init__(self, surf: Surface, rules: Dict[str, Any], base: Tuple[float, float], n_particles: int = 250, seed: int = 1):\n        self.surf = surf\n        self.rules = rules\n        self.rng = random.Random(seed)\n        self.n_p = n_particles\n        self.particles = [\n            [base[0], base[1], self.rng.uniform(-5.0, 5.0)]\n            for _ in range(self.n_p)\n        ]\n        self.weights = [1.0 / self.n_p] * self.n_p\n        self.last_pkt_tick = 0\n        self.last_bat = float(rules[\"initial_battery\"])\n        self.eff_est = float(rules[\"solar_efficiency_range\"][0])\n        self.eff_known = False\n        self.sampled_ids = set()\n\n        # 21-point discrete Bayesian posterior per terrain\n        self.slip_grid: Dict[str, List[float]] = {}\n        self.slip_prob: Dict[str, List[float]] = {}\n        for tname, (lo, hi) in PHYSICS[\"slip_base_ranges\"].items():\n            pts = [lo + (hi - lo) * i / 20.0 for i in range(21)]\n            self.slip_grid[tname] = pts\n            self.slip_prob[tname] = [1.0 / 21.0] * 21\n\n    def slip_est(self) -> Dict[str, float]:\n        return {\n            t: sum(g * p for g, p in zip(self.slip_grid[t], self.slip_prob[t]))\n            for t in self.slip_grid\n        }\n\n    def mean_state(self) -> Tuple[float, float, float]:\n        mx = sum(p[0] * w for p, w in zip(self.particles, self.weights))\n        my = sum(p[1] * w for p, w in zip(self.particles, self.weights))\n        mb = sum(p[2] * w for p, w in zip(self.particles, self.weights))\n        return mx, my, mb\n\n    def _update_slip(self, mx: float, my: float, mb: float, cmd_hdg: float, metres: float, vo: float, obs_terrain: str):\n        # Only update if terrain at start and end match obs_terrain and metres >= 1.0\n        if metres < 1.0:\n            return\n        if self.surf.terrain(mx, my) != obs_terrain:\n            return\n        pts = self.slip_grid[obs_terrain]\n        probs = self.slip_prob[obs_terrain]\n        s_est = self.slip_est()\n        h_exec = cmd_hdg + mb\n        sigma_vo = max(0.08, 0.055 * metres)\n        new_p = []\n        for s_val, pr in zip(pts, probs):\n            s_try = dict(s_est)\n            s_try[obs_terrain] = s_val\n            res = drive(self.surf, PHYSICS, mx, my, h_exec, metres, s_try, noise=0.0)\n            if res[\"stop\"] is not None:\n                new_p.append(pr)\n            else:\n                err = (vo - res[\"ground\"]) / sigma_vo\n                new_p.append(pr * math.exp(-0.5 * err * err))\n        tot = sum(new_p)\n        if tot > 1e-30:\n            self.slip_prob[obs_terrain] = [v / tot for v in new_p]\n\n    def process_packet(self, pkt: Dict[str, Any], sent_commands: Dict[int, Dict[str, Any]]):\n        tk = pkt[\"tick\"]\n        if tk <= self.last_pkt_tick:\n            return\n        self.sampled_ids = set(pkt.get(\"sampled_targets\", []))\n        if not self.eff_known and self.last_bat < 98.0 and pkt[\"charge\"] > 0.0:\n            s_sin = SOLAR_SIN[tk]\n            if s_sin > 0.1:\n                eff = pkt[\"charge\"] / s_sin\n                lo, hi = self.rules[\"solar_efficiency_range\"]\n                self.eff_est = min(hi, max(lo, eff))\n                self.eff_known = True\n\n        self.last_bat = pkt[\"battery\"]\n        self.last_pkt_tick = tk\n\n        cmd = sent_commands.get(tk, {\"action\": \"wait\"})\n        pos = pkt[\"position\"]\n        obs_ter = pkt[\"terrain\"]\n        obs_tilt = pkt[\"tilt\"]\n        vo = pkt[\"visual_odometry\"]\n        wo = pkt[\"wheel_odometry\"]\n\n        if cmd[\"action\"] == \"drive\" and wo > 0.0:\n            mx, my, mb = self.mean_state()\n            self._update_slip(mx, my, mb, float(cmd[\"heading_deg\"]), float(cmd[\"metres\"]), vo, obs_ter)\n\n        s_est = self.slip_est()\n        log_w = []\n        max_lw = -1e18\n        if cmd[\"action\"] == \"drive\" and wo > 0.0:\n            cmd_h = float(cmd[\"heading_deg\"])\n            m = float(cmd[\"metres\"])\n            for i in range(self.n_p):\n                x, y, b = self.particles[i]\n                b_new = b + self.rng.gauss(0.0, 0.2)\n                h_exec = cmd_h + b_new + self.rng.gauss(0.0, 1.5)\n                s_noise = self.rng.uniform(-0.02, 0.02)\n                res = drive(self.surf, PHYSICS, x, y, h_exec, m, s_est, noise=s_noise)\n                nx, ny = res[\"x\"], res[\"y\"]\n                self.particles[i] = [nx, ny, b_new]\n\n                ll = -0.5 * ((nx - pos[0]) ** 2 + (ny - pos[1]) ** 2)\n                sig_vo = max(0.05, 0.05 * max(0.5, res[\"ground\"]))\n                ll -= 0.5 * ((vo - res[\"ground\"]) / sig_vo) ** 2\n                if self.surf.terrain(nx, ny) != obs_ter:\n                    ll -= 3.5\n                tilt_p = self.surf.slope(nx, ny)\n                ll -= 0.5 * ((tilt_p - obs_tilt) / 0.018) ** 2\n                lw = math.log(max(1e-30, self.weights[i])) + ll\n                log_w.append(lw)\n                if lw > max_lw:\n                    max_lw = lw\n        else:\n            for i in range(self.n_p):\n                x, y, b = self.particles[i]\n                ll = -0.5 * ((x - pos[0]) ** 2 + (y - pos[1]) ** 2)\n                if self.surf.terrain(x, y) != obs_ter:\n                    ll -= 3.5\n                tilt_p = self.surf.slope(x, y)\n                ll -= 0.5 * ((tilt_p - obs_tilt) / 0.018) ** 2\n                lw = math.log(max(1e-30, self.weights[i])) + ll\n                log_w.append(lw)\n                if lw > max_lw:\n                    max_lw = lw\n\n        ws = [math.exp(lw - max_lw) for lw in log_w]\n        tot = sum(ws)\n        if tot <= 0:\n            self.weights = [1.0 / self.n_p] * self.n_p\n        else:\n            self.weights = [w / tot for w in ws]\n\n        ess = 1.0 / sum(w * w for w in self.weights)\n        if ess < 0.5 * self.n_p:\n            self._resample()\n\n    def _resample(self):\n        cdf = []\n        acc = 0.0\n        for w in self.weights:\n            acc += w\n            cdf.append(acc)\n        cdf[-1] = 1.0\n        step = 1.0 / self.n_p\n        u0 = self.rng.uniform(0.0, step)\n        new_p = []\n        idx = 0\n        for k in range(self.n_p):\n            u = u0 + k * step\n            while u > cdf[idx] and idx < self.n_p - 1:\n                idx += 1\n            px, py, pb = self.particles[idx]\n            px = min(self.surf.width, max(0.0, px + self.rng.gauss(0.0, 0.05)))\n            py = min(self.surf.height, max(0.0, py + self.rng.gauss(0.0, 0.05)))\n            pb = min(7.0, max(-7.0, pb + self.rng.gauss(0.0, 0.05)))\n            new_p.append([px, py, pb])\n        self.particles = new_p\n        self.weights = [1.0 / self.n_p] * self.n_p\n\n    def predict_state(self, target_tick: int, sent_commands: Dict[int, Dict[str, Any]], n_sample: int = 80):\n        # Stratified draw of n_sample particles, propagated from last_pkt_tick+1 .. target_tick-1\n        cdf = []\n        acc = 0.0\n        for w in self.weights:\n            acc += w\n            cdf.append(acc)\n        cdf[-1] = 1.0\n        step = 1.0 / n_sample\n        u0 = 0.5 * step\n        cloud = []\n        idx = 0\n        for k in range(n_sample):\n            u = u0 + k * step\n            while u > cdf[idx] and idx < self.n_p - 1:\n                idx += 1\n            cloud.append(list(self.particles[idx]))\n\n        s_est = self.slip_est()\n        bat = self.last_bat\n        eff_cons = self.eff_est\n        for tk in range(self.last_pkt_tick + 1, target_tick):\n            g = eff_cons * SOLAR_SIN[tk]\n            bat = min(100.0, bat + g) - IDLE_COST\n            cmd = sent_commands.get(tk, {\"action\": \"wait\"})\n            if cmd[\"action\"] == \"sample\":\n                bat -= SAMPLE_COST\n            elif cmd[\"action\"] == \"drive\":\n                cmd_h = float(cmd[\"heading_deg\"])\n                m = float(cmd[\"metres\"])\n                e_list = []\n                for p in cloud:\n                    p[2] += self.rng.gauss(0.0, 0.2)\n                    h_exec = cmd_h + p[2] + self.rng.gauss(0.0, 1.5)\n                    s_noise = self.rng.uniform(-0.02, 0.02)\n                    res = drive(self.surf, PHYSICS, p[0], p[1], h_exec, m, s_est, noise=s_noise)\n                    p[0], p[1] = res[\"x\"], res[\"y\"]\n                    e_list.append(res[\"energy\"])\n                # Use 75th percentile energy for conservative battery prediction\n                e_list.sort()\n                bat -= e_list[int(0.75 * len(e_list))]\n\n        mx = sum(p[0] for p in cloud) / len(cloud)\n        my = sum(p[1] for p in cloud) / len(cloud)\n        mb = sum(p[2] for p in cloud) / len(cloud)\n        return mx, my, mb, bat, cloud\n\n\nclass Autopilot:\n    def __init__(self, world: Dict[str, Any], rules: Dict[str, Any], seed: int = 1):\n        self.world = world\n        self.rules = rules\n        self.base = tuple(world[\"base\"])\n        self.surf = Surface(world[\"cell_m\"], world[\"elevation_cm\"], world[\"terrain\"])\n        self.nav = NavGraph(self.surf, margin=0.03)\n        self.est = StateEstimator(self.surf, rules, self.base, n_particles=250, seed=seed)\n        self.rng = random.Random(seed + 100)\n\n        self.alphas = (0.02, 0.45)\n        self.targets: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {t[\"id\"]: dict(t) for t in world[\"targets\"]}\n        self.node_ids: List[str] = [\"BASE\"] + [t[\"id\"] for t in world[\"targets\"]]\n        self.node_xy: Dict[str, Tuple[float, float]] = {\"BASE\": self.base}\n        for t in world[\"targets\"]:\n            self.node_xy[t[\"id\"]] = (t[\"x\"], t[\"y\"])\n\n        # Precompute APSP among BASE + initial targets for both alphas\n        self.dist_t: Dict[int, Dict[Tuple[str, str], float]] = {0: {}, 1: {}}\n        self.dist_e: Dict[int, Dict[Tuple[str, str], float]] = {0: {}, 1: {}}\n        self._precompute_all()\n\n        self.sent_commands: Dict[int, Dict[str, Any]] = {}\n        self.last_reserved = 0\n        self.pending_sample_ticks: Dict[str, int] = {}\n        self.current_route: List[str] = []\n        self.last_replan_tick = -999\n        self.cached_path: Optional[Tuple[str, float, List[Tuple[float, float]]]] = None\n\n    def _add_node_apsp(self, nid: str, x: float, y: float):\n        self.node_xy[nid] = (x, y)\n        if nid not in self.node_ids:\n            self.node_ids.append(nid)\n        cell = self.nav.cell\n        for m_idx, alpha in enumerate(self.alphas):\n            d_grid, e_grid = self.nav.dijkstra_from_point(x, y, alpha)\n            for other in self.node_ids:\n                ox, oy = self.node_xy[other]\n                oi, oj = round(ox / cell), round(oy / cell)\n                dt = d_grid[oj][oi]\n                de = e_grid[oj][oi]\n                self.dist_t[m_idx][(nid, other)] = dt\n                self.dist_e[m_idx][(nid, other)] = de\n                self.dist_t[m_idx][(other, nid)] = dt\n                self.dist_e[m_idx][(other, nid)] = de\n\n    def _precompute_all(self):\n        cell = self.nav.cell\n        for m_idx, alpha in enumerate(self.alphas):\n            for a in self.node_ids:\n {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794707765632,"sessionID":"ses_e23248892ffe6OTC81GbFdSDRP","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"cun0UNXm7nF2rpSU","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"import json, math, time, sys\nsys.path.insert(0, \"/tmp/opencode\")\nfrom sim_env import SimMission\nfrom autopilot_core import Autopilot, PHYSICS\n\nworld = json.load(open(\"/tmp/opencode/map.json\"))\nrules = json.load(open(\"/tmp/opencode/rules.json\"))\n\ndef run_one(seed, force_eff=None, force_max_slip=False):\n    sim = SimMission(world, rules, seed=seed)\n    if force_eff is not None:\n        sim.solar_eff = force_eff\n    if force_max_slip:\n        sim.slip_base = {k: v[1] for k, v in PHYSICS[\"slip_base_ranges\"].items()}\n    bot = Autopilot(world, rules, seed=seed * 100)\n    # Reduce particles for speed test? Let's keep 200\n    waits_chosen = 0\n    out_log = sim.advance(0)\n    arrive_base_tick = None\n    while not out_log[\"episode_complete\"]:\n        cur_t = sim.tick\n        force_replan = False\n        if out_log[\"packets\"]:\n            m_info = sim.get_map()\n            if bot.ingest_packets(out_log[\"packets\"], m_info[\"targets\"]):\n                force_replan = True\n        if cur_t <= 416:\n            cmd = bot.choose_command(cur_t, force_replan=(cur_t == 0 or force_replan))\n            if cmd is not None:\n                if cmd[\"action\"] == \"wait\":\n                    waits_chosen += 1\n                acks = sim.uplink([cmd])\n                for a in acks:\n                    bot.sent_commands[a[\"execute_tick\"]] = a[\"command\"]\n                    bot.last_reserved = max(bot.last_reserved, a[\"execute_tick\"])\n        out_log = sim.advance(1)\n        if arrive_base_tick is None and sim.tick > 350 and math.hypot(sim.x - sim.base[0], sim.y - sim.base[1]) <= 4.0:\n            arrive_base_tick = sim.tick\n    sc, cred, mult = sim.final_score()\n    min_bat = min(p[\"battery\"] for p in sim.packets)\n    stops = sum(1 for p in sim.packets for e in p[\"events\"] if e[\"type\"] == \"safety_stop\")\n    misses = sum(1 for p in sim.packets for e in p[\"events\"] if e[\"type\"] == \"sample_missed\")\n    print(f\"seed={seed} eff={sim.solar_eff:.2f} max_slip={force_max_slip}: score={sc:.3f} cred={cred:.2f} mult={mult} \"\n          f\"sampled={len(sim.sampled)} waits={waits_chosen} min_bat={min_bat:.1f} stops={stops} miss={misses} base_t={arrive_base_tick}\")\n    if seed == 1 and force_eff is None:\n        print(\"  Discoveries:\")\n        for d in sim.discoveries:\n            st = sim.sampled.get(d[\"id\"])\n            print(f\"    {d['id']} ({d['x']},{d['y']}) val={d['value']} app={d['appear_tick']} dl={d['deadline_tick']} sampled_at={st}\")\n        print(\"  True slip:\", {k: round(v,3) for k,v in sim.slip_base.items()})\n        print(\"  Est  slip:\", {k: round(v,3) for k,v in bot.est.slip_est().items()})\n\nrun_one(1)\nrun_one(1, force_eff=0.80, force_max_slip=True)\nrun_one(2)\nrun_one(3)\nrun_one(4)\nrun_one(5)\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/diag_sim.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/diag_sim.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/diag_sim.py","time":{"start":1794707765611,"end":1794707765617}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dceb3966001tkoC4IJKnnMozz","sessionID":"ses_e23248892ffe6OTC81GbFdSDRP","messageID":"msg_1dceafe90001EFkhzoksBJ1sR4"}}

self.replan(t_exec, x_pred, y_pred, bat_pred)\n\n        # Choose goal: first in current_route, unless emergency RTB\n        goal_id = self.current_route[0] if self.current_route else \"BASE\"\n {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794707813742,"sessionID":"ses_e23248892ffe6OTC81GbFdSDRP","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"JzuCTtsb6PnXFjqz","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"import json, math, time, sys\nsys.path.insert(0, \"/tmp/opencode\")\nfrom sim_env import SimMission\nfrom autopilot_core import Autopilot, PHYSICS\n\nworld = json.load(open(\"/tmp/opencode/map.json\"))\nrules = json.load(open(\"/tmp/opencode/rules.json\"))\n\nt0 = time.time()\nbase_bot = Autopilot(world, rules, seed=1)\nprecomp = (base_bot.surf, base_bot.nav, base_bot.dist_t, base_bot.dist_e)\nprint(f\"Precomputed once in {time.time()-t0:.2f}s\", flush=True)\n\ndef run_one(seed, force_eff=None, force_max_slip=False):\n    t1 = time.time()\n    sim = SimMission(world, rules, seed=seed)\n    if force_eff is not None:\n        sim.solar_eff = force_eff\n    if force_max_slip:\n        sim.slip_base = {k: v[1] for k, v in PHYSICS[\"slip_base_ranges\"].items()}\n    bot = Autopilot(world, rules, seed=seed * 100, precomputed=precomp)\n    waits_chosen = 0\n    out_log = sim.advance(0)\n    arrive_base_tick = None\n    while not out_log[\"episode_complete\"]:\n        cur_t = sim.tick\n        force_replan = False\n        if out_log[\"packets\"]:\n            m_info = sim.get_map()\n            if bot.ingest_packets(out_log[\"packets\"], m_info[\"targets\"]):\n                force_replan = True\n        if cur_t <= 416:\n            cmd = bot.choose_command(cur_t, force_replan=(cur_t == 0 or force_replan))\n            if cmd is not None:\n                if cmd[\"action\"] == \"wait\":\n                    waits_chosen += 1\n                acks = sim.uplink([cmd])\n                for a in acks:\n                    bot.sent_commands[a[\"execute_tick\"]] = a[\"command\"]\n                    bot.last_reserved = max(bot.last_reserved, a[\"execute_tick\"])\n        out_log = sim.advance(1)\n        if arrive_base_tick is None and sim.tick > 350 and math.hypot(sim.x - sim.base[0], sim.y - sim.base[1]) <= 4.0:\n            arrive_base_tick = sim.tick\n    sc, cred, mult = sim.final_score()\n    min_bat = min(p[\"battery\"] for p in sim.packets)\n    stops = sum(1 for p in sim.packets for e in p[\"events\"] if e[\"type\"] == \"safety_stop\")\n    misses = sum(1 for p in sim.packets for e in p[\"events\"] if e[\"type\"] == \"sample_missed\")\n    print(f\"seed={seed} eff={sim.solar_eff:.2f} max_slip={str(force_max_slip):5s}: score={sc:.3f} cred={cred:5.2f} mult={mult} \"\n          f\"sampled={len(sim.sampled):2d} waits={waits_chosen:2d} min_bat={min_bat:4.1f} stops={stops} miss={misses} base_t={str(arrive_base_tick):>4s} ({time.time()-t1:.1f}s)\", flush=True)\n    return sc, mult, stops, misses\n\nres = []\nres.append(run_one(1, force_eff=0.80, force_max_slip=True))\nres.append(run_one(2, force_eff=0.80, force_max_slip=True))\nfor s in range(1, 7):\n    res.append(run_one(s))\nprint(\"Mean score:\", sum(r[0] for r in res)/len(res), \"All mult=1?\", all(r[1]==1.0 for r in res), \"Total stops:\", sum(r[2] for r in res), \"Total misses:\", sum(r[3] for r in res))\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/diag_sim.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/diag_sim.py","exists":true,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/diag_sim.py","time":{"start":1794707813734,"end":1794707813740}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dcebf560001OzWojVgJuiE9q8","sessionID":"ses_e23248892ffe6OTC81GbFdSDRP","messageID":"msg_1dcebe16f001VIMpmkyYaFiEOZ"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794708162800,"sessionID":"ses_e23248892ffe6OTC81GbFdSDRP","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"edit","callID":"HhMucCQPsfodp40U","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"oldString":"    def _safe_for_cloud(self, x_mean: float, y_mean: float, bias_mean: float,\n                        cloud: List[List[float]], cmd_hdg: float, metres: float,\n                        s_est: Dict[str, float]) -> bool:\n        if (12.0 < x_mean < self.surf.width - 12.0 and\n                12.0 < y_mean < self.surf.height - 12.0 and\n                self.surf.slope(x_mean, y_mean) < 0.21):\n            checks = [\n                (x_mean, y_mean, bias_mean),\n                (x_mean + 1.3, y_mean, bias_mean + 3.0),\n                (x_mean - 1.3, y_mean, bias_mean - 3.0),\n                (x_mean, y_mean + 1.3, bias_mean),\n                (x_mean, y_mean - 1.3, bias_mean),\n            ]\n        else:\n            checks = []\n            for dx, dy in [(0, 0), (1.3, 0), (-1.3, 0), (0, 1.3), (0, -1.3), (1.0, 1.0), (-1.0, -1.0)]:\n                for db in (-3.8, 0.0, 3.8):\n                    checks.append((x_mean + dx, y_mean + dy, bias_mean + db))\n            step_p = max(1, len(cloud) // 8)\n            for p in cloud[::step_p]:\n                for db in (-3.5, 3.5):\n                    checks.append((p[0], p[1], p[2] + db))\n\n        for px, py, pb in checks:\n            if not self.surf.inside(px, py):\n                return False\n            res = drive(self.surf, PHYSICS, px, py, cmd_hdg + pb, metres, s_est, noise=-0.02)\n            if res[\"stop\"] in (\"tilt\", \"map_boundary\"):\n                return False\n        return True\n\n    def choose_command(self, current_tick: int, force_replan: bool = False) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:\n        t_exec = max(current_tick + self.rules[\"delay_ticks\"] + 1, self.last_reserved + 1)\n        if t_exec > MAX_TICKS:\n            return None\n\n        x_pred, y_pred, bias_pred, bat_pred, cloud = self.est.predict_state(t_exec, self.sent_commands)\n\n        # Clean route of already sampled or pending targets\n        self.current_route = [\n            tid for tid in self.current_route\n            if tid not in self.est.sampled_ids and tid not in self.pending_sample_ticks\n        ]\n\n        if force_replan or (t_exec - self.last_replan_tick >= 45) or (not self.current_route and t_exec < 350):\n            self.replan(t_exec, x_pred, y_pred, bat_pred)\n\n        # Choose goal: first in current_route, unless emergency RTB\n        goal_id = self.current_route[0] if self.current_route else \"BASE\"\n        if goal_id != \"BASE\":\n            gx, gy = self.node_xy[goal_id]\n            _, dt_to_goal, de_to_goal = self.nav.find_path(x_pred, y_pred, gx, gy, 0.02)\n            dt_goal_to_base = self.dist_t[0][(goal_id, \"BASE\")]\n            de_goal_to_base = self.dist_e[0][(goal_id, \"BASE\")]\n            tot_dt = dt_to_goal * 1.06 + 1 + dt_goal_to_base * 1.06\n            tot_de = de_to_goal * 1.06 + SAMPLE_COST + de_goal_to_base * 1.06 + IDLE_COST * tot_dt\n            t_arr = min(MAX_TICKS, int(t_exec + tot_dt))\n            solar_avail = self.est.eff_est * (SOLAR_PRE[t_arr] - SOLAR_PRE[t_exec - 1])\n            bat_deficit = max(0.0, tot_de - (bat_pred - 3.0 + solar_avail))\n            waits_est = bat_deficit / max(0.5, self.est.eff_est * SOLAR_SIN[min(MAX_TICKS, t_arr)] - {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794708396815,"sessionID":"ses_e23248892ffe6OTC81GbFdSDRP","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"jK03KMGsbGESYbL5","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"import json\nimport math\nimport sys\nimport time\n\nsys.path.insert(0, \"/app\")\nsys.path.insert(0, \"/tmp/opencode\")\n\nfrom lightlag_client import connect, RemoteToolError\nfrom autopilot_core import Autopilot\n\ndef main():\n    t_start = time.time()\n    print(\"Connecting to http://lightlag:8000/mcp ...\", flush=True)\n    with connect(\"http://lightlag:8000/mcp\") as tools:\n        rules = tools.rules()\n        world = tools.map()\n        tlog = tools.telemetry_log()\n        print(f\"Loaded map ({world['width']}x{world['height']}, {len(world['targets'])} targets), \"\n              f\"initial log len={len(tlog)}, tick={tlog[-1]['tick']}\", flush=True)\n\n        t0 = time.time()\n        bot = Autopilot(world, rules, seed=42)\n        print(f\"Autopilot initialized in {time.time() - t0:.2f}s\", flush=True)\n\n        cur_t = tlog[-1][\"tick\"]\n        bot.ingest_packets(tlog, world[\"targets\"])\n        episode_complete = (cur_t >= rules[\"max_ticks\"])\n\n        while not episode_complete:\n            force_replan = (cur_t == 0)\n            if cur_t <= rules[\"max_ticks\"] - rules[\"delay_ticks\"] - 1:\n                cmd = bot.choose_command(cur_t, force_replan=force_replan)\n                if cmd is not None:\n                    try:\n                        acks = tools.uplink([cmd])\n                        for a in acks:\n                            bot.sent_commands[a[\"execute_tick\"]] = a[\"command\"]\n                            bot.last_reserved = max(bot.last_reserved, a[\"execute_tick\"])\n                    except RemoteToolError as e:\n                        print(f\"[WARN] uplink rejected at tick {cur_t}: {e} (cmd={cmd})\", flush=True)\n                step_n = 1\n            else:\n                step_n = min(rules[\"max_advance_ticks\"], rules[\"max_ticks\"] - cur_t)\n                if step_n <= 0:\n                    break\n\n            out = tools.advance(step_n)\n            cur_t = out[\"current_tick\"]\n            episode_complete = out[\"episode_complete\"]\n            pkts = out.get(\"packets\", [])\n\n            if pkts:\n                has_discovery = any(\n                    ev.get(\"type\") == \"target_discovered\"\n                    for p in pkts for ev in p.get(\"events\", [])\n                )\n                world_targets = tools.map()[\"targets\"] if has_discovery else None\n                need_replan = bot.ingest_packets(pkts, world_targets)\n\n                for p in pkts:\n                    for ev in p.get(\"events\", []):\n                        print(f\"[EVENT @ tick {p['tick']} recv {cur_t}] {ev}\", flush=True)\n\n                if need_replan and cur_t <= rules[\"max_ticks\"] - rules[\"delay_ticks\"] - 1:\n                    t_exec = max(cur_t + rules[\"delay_ticks\"] + 1, bot.last_reserved + 1)\n                    if t_exec <= rules[\"max_ticks\"]:\n                        xp, yp, _, bp, _ = bot.est.predict_state(t_exec, bot.sent_commands)\n                        bot.replan(t_exec, xp, yp, bp)\n\n            if cur_t % 25 == 0 or episode_complete:\n                mx, my, mb = bot.est.mean_state()\n                goal = bot.current_route[0] if bot.current_route else \"BASE\"\n                print(\n                    f\"[tick {cur_t:3d}] est=({mx:5.1f},{my:5.1f},bias={mb:+4.2f}) \"\n                    f\"bat={bot.est.last_bat:5.1f} eff={bot.est.eff_est:.3f}(known={bot.est.eff_known}) \"\n                    f\"sampled={len(bot.est.sampled_ids)} goal={goal} \"\n                    f\"route_len={len(bot.current_route)} elapsed={time.time()-t_start:.1f}s\",\n                    flush=True\n                )\n\n        # Final telemetry summary\n        final_log = tools.telemetry_log()\n        final_map = tools.map()\n        with open(\"/tmp/opencode/final_telemetry.json\", \"w\") as f:\n            json.dump(final_log, f)\n        with open(\"/tmp/opencode/final_map.json\", \"w\") as f:\n            json.dump(final_map, f)\n\n        last_pkt = final_log[-1]\n        sampled = set(last_pkt[\"sampled_targets\"])\n        sample_ticks = {}\n        for p in final_log:\n            for ev in p.get(\"events\", []):\n                if ev.get(\"type\") == \"sampled\":\n                    sample_ticks[ev[\"target_id\"]] = p[\"tick\"]\n\n        all_targets = {t[\"id\"]: t for t in final_map[\"targets\"]}\n        credited = 0.0\n        for tid in sampled:\n            tinfo = all_targets.get(tid)\n            if tinfo:\n                st = sample_ticks.get(tid, 999)\n                if tinfo[\"deadline_tick\"] is None or st <= tinfo[\"deadline_tick\"]:\n                    credited += tinfo[\"value\"]\n                else:\n                    credited += tinfo[\"late_value\"]\n        total_known_val = sum(t[\"value\"] for t in final_map[\"targets\"])\n        mx, my, _ = bot.est.mean_state()\n        dist_base = math.hypot(mx - world[\"base\"][0], my - world[\"base\"][1])\n        print(\"\\n=== MISSION COMPLETE ===\", flush=True)\n        print(f\"Tick: {last_pkt['tick']}, Alive: {last_pkt['alive']}, Battery: {last_pkt['battery']:.2f}\", flush=True)\n        print(f\"Final est pos: ({mx:.2f}, {my:.2f}), dist to base: {dist_base:.2f}m (base_radius={rules['base_radius']})\", flush=True)\n        print(f\"Sampled {len(sampled)} targets: {sorted(sample_ticks.items(), key=lambda x: x[1])}\", flush=True)\n        print(f\"Estimated credited value: {credited:.2f} / {total_known_val:.2f} (ratio={credited/total_known_val:.3f})\", flush=True)\n        print(f\"Learned eff: {bot.est.eff_est:.4f}, slip: { {k: round(v, 4) for k, v in bot.est.slip_est().items()} }\", flush=True)\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/run_mission.py"},"output":"Wrote file
